import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    return (params[0]*np.sin(params[1]*np.sqrt(t))
            + params[2]*(t*np.log(t))*(x**1.5)
            + params[3]*x**params[4]*v**params[5]
            + params[6]*x**params[7]*v**params[8]
            + params[9])
